title: Signed Rule-Version DIO structural vectors are missing
description: Shared vectors cover unsigned DIO serialization and signed timing options, but no signed authenticated DIO cases for SCHC Rule-Version option 0x13 absent, malformed length, duplicate, compatible v3, or incompatible version. Add executable shared vectors and Python/Rust consumers proving structural admission and mismatch behavior from signed replay-accepted evidence.
notes: Implemented deterministic signed corpus test/vectors/authenticated_schc_dio.json (11 cases) plus generator and Python Link->SCHC->RPL consumer. Covers compatible v3, absent, malformed len0/len2, duplicate, incompatible v2, DODAG/role scope, signer/source IID binding, valid root AddrForKey, and attacker root-DODAG impersonation. Coordinated format with Rust convergence agent. Python gates: 500 vector tests, 726 rpl+schc tests, Ruff, strict mypy, diff-check; deterministic SHA-256 18b54cfa30a03874b218560b7864305eab4cb4311c77d0214783a78b7d10aa5f. Leave open for independent convergence.
